headline: Musk rebrands SpaceX AI unit SpaceXSI after Trump order
summary: Elon Musk plans to rename SpaceXAI as SpaceXSI, following Trump's executive order adopting the 'Super Intelligence' moniker in place of 'Artificial Intelligence.'

claims.statement: Musk plans to rename SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI to match the new 'Super Intelligence' terminology from Trump's executive order.

sources.quote: Elon Musk says he plans to rename SpaceXAI as SpaceXSI to reflect the new "Super Intelligence" moniker adopted in President Trump's executive order
Musk follows Trump's lead, swaps AI for SI in SpaceX rebrand
